title: What helps reduce nausea in pregnancy
intro: Nausea and vomiting are very common in early pregnancy and are often called morning sickness, although they can occur at any time of day. They usually start around six weeks and ease by about sixteen to twenty weeks. Simple measures help many women, and medicines are available when needed.

sections.heading: Why it happens
paragraphs: The cause is not fully understood, but rising pregnancy hormones are thought to play a role. Nausea is not harmful to the baby in most cases. It is more common in a first pregnancy, multiple pregnancy and in women who have had it before. Stress, tiredness and strong smells can make it worse.

sections.heading: Food and drink tips
paragraphs: Eat small, frequent meals and keep plain snacks such as crackers by the bed to eat before getting up. Avoid fatty, spicy or very sweet foods and any smells that trigger nausea. Drink small sips of fluids throughout the day, cold drinks or ginger tea may be easier. Rest well.

sections.heading: Other measures
paragraphs: Ginger in the form of tea, biscuits or capsules has been found helpful for some women. Acupressure wristbands and acupuncture have shown mixed results, but are safe for many. Vitamin B6 can reduce nausea. Take prenatal vitamins with food, or ask about a switch if they make nausea worse.

sections.heading: Medicines
paragraphs: If measures do not help, doctors can prescribe antiemetic medicines that are considered safe in pregnancy, such as certain antihistamines or doxylamine with vitamin B6. Do not take medicines or herbal remedies without checking with your doctor or midwife.

sections.heading: When to seek help
paragraphs: Severe vomiting with weight loss, dehydration, inability to keep down fluids, dark urine, dizziness or weakness may indicate hyperemesis gravidarum, a serious form that needs medical care and sometimes hospital treatment with fluids. Contact your midwife or doctor if you cannot eat or drink for a day.

examples.title: Starting the day
examples.text: Imagine you feel sick each morning. You could keep dry crackers by your bed and eat one slowly before getting up.

examples.title: Seeking help
examples.text: Suppose you have vomited all day and cannot keep water down. You might call your midwife or doctor the same day.
